name: 占位示例
desc: 临时占位词书：旧两本已删、新 5 本（scripts/gen-wordbook.mjs 生成）就绪前，让依赖真实词书的功能与测试可用。【删除时机】务必在【运行 gen-wordbook.mjs 之前】删除本文件——否则这 5 个占位词（significant/controversial/inevitable/fundamental/phenomenon 全是高频词）会被脚本阶段2 的全局去重拦下、永久进不了正式词书；若已生成完才删，需重跑一次脚本补缺。

words.example: There has been a significant increase in the number of people working from home.
Whether children should own smartphones remains a controversial issue.
With automation advancing, job displacement seems inevitable.
Access to clean water is a fundamental human right.
Urbanisation is a global phenomenon that shows no signs of slowing down.
